files.name: receipt-scanner-operations.md
files.content:
---
name: receipt-scanner-operations
description: How Receipt Scanner runs locally and the OCR retry quirk that wastes an afternoon if forgotten
metadata:
  type: project
---

Local stack runs with `make dev` (API on :8000, worker on :8001); the OCR vendor sandbox rejects the second request in a burst with a 429 that has no Retry-After header, so the worker's backoff has to be fixed-delay rather than header-driven.

**Why:** three separate debugging sessions have started with 'the OCR is flaky' when the cause is the missing header.

**How to apply:** before touching retry logic, reproduce with `scripts/burst-test.sh`. Related: [[vendor-ocr-reference]].

files.name: small-commits-preference.md
files.content:
---
name: small-commits-preference
description: Split mechanical refactors from behaviour changes into separate commits
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Keep pure refactors (renames, moves, formatting) in their own commit, separate from any behaviour change.

**Why:** stated during the parser rewrite — a mixed commit made it impossible to tell which hunk changed the rounding behaviour.

**How to apply:** when a change needs both, do the refactor first, run the tests, commit, then make the behavioural edit.

files.name: demo-person-profile.md
files.content:
---
name: demo-person-profile
description: Backend-leaning full-stack developer; strong Python/Go, deliberately learning TypeScript
metadata:
  type: user
---

Writes Python and Go daily and is comfortable being terse there; is learning TypeScript on purpose and wants type-level reasoning spelled out rather than assumed.

**Why:** asked for explanations of conditional types twice while shipping Go changes with no commentary.

**How to apply:** in TS, explain the type reasoning; in Python/Go, skip the tutorial.

files.name: vendor-ocr-reference.md
files.content:
---
name: vendor-ocr-reference
description: OCR vendor docs, rate limits, and where the sandbox key lives
metadata:
  type: reference
---

API docs: https://example.com/docs/ocr/v2 — sandbox is 10 req/min, production 600 req/min. The sandbox key is in 1Password under 'OCR sandbox', never in the repo.

Related: [[receipt-scanner-operations]].
